title: Smart Import: Bring Your Existing Work
use_cases: Use when migrating an existing manuscript to a new PlotForge project
Implement when adding individual chapters to an active project for AI analysis
Configure when importing character bibles to populate worldbuilding and relationship data
Use when extracting timeline events and world history from legacy documents
content:
Import manuscripts, chapters, or character sheets and let AI extract your story data automatically.

Already have work in progress? PlotForge offers three powerful import options: full manuscript import for new projects, chapter-by-chapter import to build incrementally, and character sheet import to populate your cast. AI analyzes your documents to extract characters, worldbuilding, relationships, timeline events, and consistency items.

#### 📚 Manuscript Import

- Create new project from manuscript
- Full chapter text imported
- Story outline with emotional arcs
- Up to 200,000 words
- Auto-detects chapter markers

#### 📄 Chapter Import

- Add chapters to existing projects
- Extracts new characters found
- Adds worldbuilding elements
- Creates timeline events
- Builds consistency items

#### 👥 Character Import

- Import character sheets/bibles
- Full profile extraction
- Auto-links relationships
- Extracts worldbuilding too
- Skips existing characters

#### Supported Formats

- DOCX: Microsoft Word documents
- Markdown: .md files from any editor
- Plain Text: .txt files

#### What Gets Extracted

- Characters with full profiles and relationships
- Worldbuilding: locations, factions, magic, history
- Timeline events and consistency items
- Available on Starter and Pro plans
